Earn power-ups by completing passes on offense and sacking the opposing QB on defense: [/p][p][/p][p]Offensive Power-Ups [/p][list][*][p]Hocus Pocus – A pass play which results in a receiver teleporting down field.[/p][/*][*][p]Sonic Boom – A run play which causes an earthquake to knock over the opposing team.[/p][/*][*][p]Leap Frog – A run play which causes your running back to leap down field.[/p][/*][*][p]Super Punt – A very powerful punt![/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Defensive Power-Ups [/p][list][*][p]Cough Drop – A play that causes the opponent to fumble when tackled.[/p][/*][*][p]Chameleon – A trick play that results in your team wearing the other team's colors for ultimate confusion.[/p][/*][*][p]Spring Loaded – A play that causes your player to leap over the line of scrimmage to sack the QB.[/p][/*][*][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re reliving your childhood or discovering this gem for the first time, get ready to huddle up for Backyard Football![/p]

notes.title: Backyard Baseball 2001 is Here!
notes.notes:
[p][i]From the soccer field to the sandlot — the backyard universe gets even bigger![/i][/p][p]Hey Backyard Soccer ’98 fans — it’s time to swap goals for home runs! [b]Backyard Baseball 2001[/b] has officially launched on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3104970/Backyard_Baseball_01/"]Steam[/url], [url="https://apps.apple.com/app/id6740349587"]iOS[/url], and [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pgp.bybb01"]Android[/url], bringing your favorite neighborhood kids (and iconic pros) to the baseball diamond.[/p][p]Many of the backyard legends you know from the soccer field — like Pablo Sanchez, Achmed Khan, Kiesha Phillips, and more — are back and ready to take a swing at baseball glory.[/p][p]Build your ultimate lineup from [b]28 of the original 31 pro superstars[/b], including Derek Jeter, Cal Ripken Jr., and fan favorite Kenny Lofton.[/p][p][/p][p]Choose your game mode:[/p][list][*][p][b]Random Pick-up[/b] — Jump straight into a quick backyard match with randomly chosen teams.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Single Game[/b] — Draft your squad from a random character pool and challenge the computer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season Mode[/b] — Pick your home field, manage your team through a 14-game season, battle through the BBL playoffs, and fight to become champions in the [b]Super Entire Nation Tournament and Ultra Grand Championship of the Universe Series[/b]![/p][/*][/list][p]Packed with fun power-ups, classic fields, and the same backyard charm you loved in Soccer ’98, Backyard Baseball 2001 is the perfect way to keep the backyard adventures going all year long.[/p][p][b]Play now and continue your backyard legacy![/b]
Don’t forget to wishlist and spread the word — the backyard is calling.[/p][p]#PlayYourWay #BackyardBaseball2001[/p]

notes.title: Backyard Soccer ’98 Update Alert 🚨
notes.notes:
[h3]Hi-ho! We’ve rolled out a patch to further improve your experience
[/h3]

[b]v.1.0.2[/b]

[b]Steam Achievements are now fixed![/b] Here’s the list of previously unattainable achievements:
[list]
[*] [b]Shot Out[/b] - lose in a shoot out/penalty kick
[*] [b]Round Table [/b]- score with every player in a game
[*] [b]Oops[/b] - lose a season game
[*] [b]Can Stop, Will Stop[/b] - lose 10 season games
[*] [b]Goal Getter[/b] - score 10 goals (no longer triggered by opponents scoring goals)
[/list]

[b]Other fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed window scaling issues on high DPI displays.
[*] Fixed a game launch issue with DEP enabled and resolved the glitchy cursor on high DPI displays.
[*] Steam Rich Presence - Your friends now see you're playing Backyard Soccer '98.
[/list]

[b]To make sure you’re playing the latest version, follow these steps to download the Steam update:[/b]
[olist]
[*]Open the Steam application.
[*]Click Library at the top.
[*]Right-click on Backyard Soccer '98.
[*]Select Properties from the drop-down menu.
[*]Head to the Updates tab.
[*]Choose how you’d like to update the game.
[*]Steam will begin updating the game.
[/olist]


:warning: Note: While this patch continues to address some current issues, please remember that certain bugs from the original game may still exist. Without access to the original source code, some legacy problems remain beyond our control. But rest assured, we’re doing our best to make your experience as smooth as possible!


If you encounter any problems, we’d love to hear from you!

:point_right: Report a bug [url=https://bit.ly/3AYksgr] here[/url]

Join our community on [url=https://discord.com/invite/megacat]Discord[/url]

Thanks for your continued support, and let’s keep the fun going!

notes.title: Backyard Soccer '98 Coming November 27th!
notes.notes:
Lace up those cleats and hit the pitch at Playground Commons, because the original Backyard Soccer is back Noveber 27, and better than ever. Who do you have for your starting five? The GOAT, Pablo Sanchez? Luanne Lui? Vicki Kawaguchi? Ricky Johnson? Stephanie Morgan? Dante Robinson? Choose wisely, your season depends on it!

The team at Mega Cat Studios has lovingly worked their little cleats off to bring this classic title back to Steam for PC and Steam Deck. The charming gameplay returns with a hilarious roster of kids, customizable teams and uniforms, 20 unique Backyard fields, 3 skill levels, intuitive point-and-click controls, and exciting tournament modes.

Wishlist now, and return on November 27th to join in on the fun!
